verdict.rationale: Pulley's first-party product pages say it offers audit-defensible 409A valuations from its own expert team with a three-day turnaround, which covers the core of ordering an audit-ready 409A. Nothing shows the valuation is generated from live cap table data or refreshed on a schedule. Missing for 10: evidence the 409A is generated from live cap table data, scheduled or recurring refreshes, documentation of the in-platform ordering flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
